decisions.NES18: Selected qualified native memory execution for neighboring-room guest services; existing persistent actors/timers/RNG and activation cadence preserved. Further persistent scratch contexts deferred on attribution. Qualified Fit performance and dungeon/adaptive/all-map correctness; no exhaustive content audit.
decisions.NES20: Evaluated and deferred full snapshot replacement: capture/restore was 3.018% of measured scoped wall time versus 96.982% guest execution. This is a priority decision, not a claim that copies are free or impossible to optimize.

limitations: Only Zelda selects NESRECOMP_ISOLATED_NATIVE=1; other titles retain preprocessed C identical to the prior implementation with flag0.
Boards0/1/4/66 qualify; board2 and unsupported cases retain fallback. PAL and NTSC isolated fixtures keep device clocks frozen. No full-game PAL performance claim.
Final supported combined regeneration/features and owner visual handoff remain before main/master merge/release.
Pre-existing Remastered missing selectscreen.png and unsupported pack rules are shared. Other deferred Zelda mechanics in beads-2dw.18.4 remain deferred.
Steam Deck was probed but has no installed compiler/qualified game runtime; no installs or Deck timing were performed.
No FDS images/execution; owner saves/settings preserved; no owner-facing game launches.
